items.title: The product of two spectral spaces is spectral
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the stability of the spectral property under products (author lemma at source lines 4787-4790, label lemma-product-spectral-spaces). The proof (source lines 4792-4819) verifies the two non-trivial halves of the definition: sobriety is obtained by taking a closed irreducible subset, passing to the closures of its two projections and using their generic points to force the pair of generic points into the subset (proof lines 4793-4812), and the basis condition is checked by noting that products of quasi-compact opens form a basis and that intersecting two of them stays in that family because the factors are spectral (proof lines 4813-4818). The statement is used later for products of spectral spaces, in particular for the Stone-Cech material of the chapter. H2.
